## Why visit

A justified architecture-only exception to the real-ale emphasis. The curved corridor, brilliant tilework, mosaic floor and decorated service-screen glass form one of the area’s most compelling pub interiors. It is especially interesting after the Lion Tavern because the related corner-pub layout can be read directly in the rooms. Visit for that survival and have whatever suitable drink is available; then use nearby Gallaghers for the cask portion of the excursion. This is a spectacular pub recommendation, not a claim about its beer range.

CAMRA three-star historic interior. Do not promise real ale or an extensive craft range. Ask staff before inspecting occupied rooms.

**Getting there:** Price Street near Conway Park; combine with Hamilton Square and Gallaghers.
